headerDisplay: Control your RIKA Firenet pellet stove from Apple Home. Provide your RIKA Firenet account credentials below.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown for the platform in the Homebridge logs.

email.title: RIKA Firenet Email
email.description: The email address of your rika-firenet.com account.

password.title: RIKA Firenet Password
password.description: The password of your rika-firenet.com account.

stoveID.title: Stove ID
stoveID.description: Required. The numeric stove identifier (visible in the rika-firenet.com URL).

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to refresh the stove status. RIKA recommends a minimum of 60 seconds.
